---
name: Feature or design proposal
about: Propose a scoped improvement
title: '[Proposal] '
labels: 'type:design'
---

## Problem and related scope

Describe the user problem and link related numbered issues, epic or release. Explain why existing behavior or documentation does not already address it. Proposing work does not admit it to a release.

## Proposed behavior and boundaries

State inputs, outputs and compatibility. For numerical changes define formulas, units, timing/known-at availability, initialization, coverage and edge cases before code. Calculations stay source-independent; fetching, credentials, files/databases, scheduling and publication belong outside them.

## Acceptance and independent checks

Provide concrete acceptance criteria, independent synthetic expected results, the relevant runnable check and documentation impact. Performance proposals need measured workload and parity; distinguish planned checks from actual results.

## Prerequisites, rights and delivery

Name dependencies and unresolved decisions without inventing access or data rights. Keep private data/credentials and unlicensed code out. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/atulsrivas1/equity-features/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for code and non-code paths, actual contributor credit and support limits. Maintainer scope/readiness, separate review and release gates apply; a proposal or merged patch alone is not acceptance.
